capability: Explain edge-connected triangle islands and edge defects in a bounded OBJ mesh.
user: CAD/export pipeline maintainers inspecting a triangulated OBJ before downstream processing.
pain: Disconnected parts, seam duplicates and orientation conflicts need attributable face/edge evidence rather than an unexplained pass/fail.
expected: The invented OBJ has two separate closed tetrahedral edge surfaces, eight faces and no reported edge defects; exit 0. Multiple closed islands alone are not an error.
contract: UTF-8 OBJ triangle faces only. Positive and relative negative indices are validated at the face declaration, including texture/normal references. Exact-coordinate welding always applies. --weld-decimals 0–9 adds half-even decimal-grid quantization, not a Euclidean distance tolerance. Degenerate and duplicate faces are reported and excluded before edge incidence and island grouping. Point-touch contacts remain separate edge islands and are reported. Metadata is counted; materials are never loaded.
limits: 2 MiB, 20,000 vertices and 30,000 triangle faces. Coordinates: zero or absolute magnitude 1e-12 through 1e9, bounded decimal precision. No polygons, freeform curves, repair, self-intersection detection, vertex-manifold certification, solid volume or printability guarantee. closed_edge_surface only means each retained component edge has incidence two; it is not a full watertightness claim. Area is approximate.
acceptance: Recover two closed islands, attribute boundary/nonmanifold/orientation/contact defects, validate interleaved relative indices and reject forward/zero references and unsupported polygons.
notes: Open3D already clusters connected triangles and computes manifold evidence. Trimesh already offers adjacency, splitting and watertightness operations; MeshLab offers a broad interactive processing workflow. Trimesh PR 2620 discusses interleaved OBJ relative indices. Our explicit small-file evidence report is a narrower interface, not an absent competitor feature.
alternatives: Open3D or Trimesh scripts, or interactive MeshLab filters.
overlap: No existing owned repository is a triangle OBJ topology inspector. Point-table, GIS and media index tools do not implement OBJ face incidence or coordinate welding.
